filtered_IK.identity_scope: Exact algebraic decomposition of meanF = stance_fraction*stance_meanF + swing_fraction*swing_meanF; terms are not causal shares.

actual_saved.identity_scope: Exact algebraic decomposition of meanF = stance_fraction*stance_meanF + swing_fraction*swing_meanF; terms are not causal shares.

basis07_raw_stance_shape_constant_shift_.interpretation: Raw signed depth avoids zero clipping. A small residual relative to a constant offset is compatible with an offset-like shape; it does not uniquely establish registration causality. No profile fitting, force correction, time shift or significance test.

methodology.primary_cycles: Same immutable3cycles per subject from paired selection; startup/rest of9s excluded.
methodology.stance_swing: Measured-force20N oracle HS→TO is stance, TO→nextHS is swing, not online FSM or binary geometry events.
methodology.integration: Piecewise-linear recorded force/depth curves, native1ms interior plus exactHS/TO/nextHS boundaries; trapezoidal integration with exact endpoint insertion.
methodology.basis07: Depth=radius−signed plane distance; positive penetration=max(depth,0). Exact analytical normal forceK*smoothPositive(depth)*smoothPositive(1), exponent1,dissipation0, vertical residual locked. The final constant preserves the production smoothing of the zero-dissipation multiplier. No newFK.
methodology.shape: 20 equal measured-stance phase bins. Per-cycle means and duration-weighted pooled means; normalization of phase only for descriptive shape, never main impulse/timing scoring.
methodology.actual: Native saved force and maximum sphere penetration. Basis07 geometry was not recorded for actual, so sphere-specific fields stay null; no replacement by maximum penetration.
methodology.force_intervals: All20N force intervals intersecting primary, with source-support/censored ends retained. These are force crossings, not HS/TO detector/FSM semantics.
methodology.dominant_sphere: left_basis_07 selected from the previous frozen audit, not newly optimized on phase data.

limitations: Experimental stance/swing belongs to the healthy measured limb; the simulated left contact belongs to virtual prosthetic hardware. Force in measured swing establishes temporal incompatibility, not a unique registration error or an experimental hardware fault.
No independent physical sole/floor data are added. Small marker residuals and offset-like depth shapes alone cannot identify a true floor or contact material law.
There is one trial per subject. Three cycles describe within-trial variability; no significance or population anatomical attribution is claimed.

The native secondary uses interpolation of measured force on the saved native grid before exactevent insertion; tiny integration differences from the earlier official paired comparator do not replace official percentages.
The force>20N interval view does not pair missed/extra online events or reconstruct canceled FSM HS.
AB06 original terminal callback failure is preserved; the primary physical windows are fully supported.
